description: Upload a deal file: job_input (buyer, while NEGOTIATING; its SHA-256 must equal the deal's request_ref) or deliverable (provider, while IN_FULFILLMENT or PROOF_SUBMITTED). Raw size cap 160 KiB; idempotent on identical bytes.

content_b64.description: std-base64 of the raw file bytes (raw size cap 160 KiB)

deal_id.description: the deal to attach the file to; caller must be the appropriate deal party

kind.description: the file kind: job_input (buyer, while NEGOTIATING; its SHA-256 must equal the deal's request_ref sha256:<hex>) or deliverable (provider, while IN_FULFILLMENT or PROOF_SUBMITTED)

name: upload_deal_file
